fpv.name: VECTOR / Indoor FPV
fpv.design_status: Initial spacious layout. VRC+ drone feel and PC/Quest frame timing require an in-client playtest.
fpv.drone_implementation: Use the user's VRC+ Camera Drone; no world drone, controller, physics or race timer.

kart.name: APEX / NEON SWITCHYARD
kart.art_direction: Enclosed industrial kart hall; cyan, violet and pink LED rails; dark glossy asphalt; close barriers, hairpins, underpasses and overhead trusses. Photographs inform atmosphere only; the route is original.
kart.external_vehicle_system: CHIKUWA VEHICLE SYSTEM 2 (CVS2), installed by the world owner
kart.runtime_status: CVS2 steering, vehicle dimensions, multiplayer, lightmap baking and PC/Quest frame timings require Unity/VRChat validation.
